title: Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care — Presumptive Bases and Screening Settings
content:
## Presumptive settings of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care)

Every tier (Riverbend Presumptive Charity Care; Riverbend Full Charity Care (0-200% FPL); Riverbend 80% Charity Discount (201-250% FPL); Riverbend 60% Charity Discount (251-300% FPL); Riverbend 40% Charity Discount (301-400% FPL); Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance (above 400% FPL)) records the same presumptive settings:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Presumptive bases that qualify for presumptive charity care | Medicaid eligible on non-covered dates; SNAP or WIC enrolled; homeless; deceased with no estate; propensity score |
| When every self-pay patient-due account is screened presumptively | before placement with a collection agency |
| Estimated household FPL percent at or below which a third-party propensity score qualifies as presumptive evidence | 200.0 |

The presumptive tier itself is entered by a presumptive screen with one of these bases on record; no application is required for it.

### Boundary of the propensity score (hypothetical estimates)

| Estimated household FPL percent from the propensity score | Qualifies as presumptive evidence |
|---|---|
| 200.0 | yes (at most 200.0) |
| 200.1 | no |
